class.name: threevn_hardware/Esp32SystemInterface
class.description:
Drives the physical 3VN arm through an ESP32 over a framed binary serial protocol. The control loop runs here on the host at 50 Hz; the device is a servo driver that clamps limits independently.
This class name is referenced by arm.ros2_control.xacro and has been since Phase 1, which is what made Phase 5 purely additive.

class.name: threevn_hardware/FeetechSystemInterface
class.description:
Drives an arm built from Feetech STS-series bus servos (the SO-101) over their half-duplex serial protocol, through a serial port or a TCP socket. There is no firmware of ours on the far side: the servos are the closed-loop controllers, and this reads their positions and writes their goals at the control rate.
The class name is the one so101_follower.yaml has named since the profile was written, which is what made adding it additive.
